name: Centro Cultural de España en Malabo (CCEM)
subtitle: Influential cultural center and library catalyzing contemporary art, theatre, and literature in Spanish-speaking Africa.

facts.label: Facilities
facts.value: Auditorium, contemporary gallery spaces, film projection rooms, and public library

facts.label: Focus
facts.value: Promoting Equatoguinean playwrights, visual artists, and Afro-Hispanic intercultural dialogue

parts.text: A leading cultural institution in Equatorial Guinea, situated in central Malabo. Serving as a crucial incubator for local writers, contemporary painters, sculptors, and musicians in sub-Saharan Africa's only Spanish-speaking sovereign nation, the CCEM hosts regular art exhibitions, film festivals, performing arts residencies, and literary conferences, fostering dynamic artistic exchange between Africa, Spain, and the wider Atlantic.

gaps: Digital repository of past exhibition catalogues and Equatoguinean play scripts is under development.
